headline: JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures submits postal ballot scrutinizer report
summary: JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of a postal ballot to the stock exchange. Routine corporate governance filing completes the postal ballot process. Shareholders voted on resolutions presented through the postal ballot. The filing is a procedural update with no immediate financial impact for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate filing with no direct impact on stock price
